title: 性格與強項問卷
instrument: IPIP-VIA-R 核心強項短版（18 題）
instrumentEn: IPIP-VIA-R Core Strengths short form (18 items)

source.citation: Partsch, M. V., Olaru, G., & Lechner, C. M. (2022). Measuring global character dimensions: An ant colony optimization approach towards three core strengths scales. PsyArXiv. https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/tdjh4

translationNote: 中文題目是團隊試譯（J2、K 各自翻譯，再由第三位組員回譯比對），未經香港樣本驗證。
translationNoteEn: The Chinese items are the team's trial translation (two independent translations plus a back-translation check). They have not been validated with a Hong Kong sample.

scales.label: 積極
scales.about: 保持希望、懂得感恩，並與身邊的人保持連繫。
scales.aboutEn: Staying hopeful, feeling grateful and staying connected with people around you.
scales.work: 在壓力大的項目中幫團隊保持士氣；主動給隊友正面回饋；被拒絕後較快重新出發。
scales.workEn: Keep team morale up on high-pressure projects, give teammates positive feedback, and bounce back quickly after a rejection.
scales.interview: 準備一個你在困難中保持動力、並帶動身邊的人的例子。
scales.interviewEn: Prepare an example of staying motivated through a setback and lifting the people around you.

scales.label: 可靠
scales.about: 做決定謹慎、待人公平誠實，並且謙遜。
scales.aboutEn: Making careful decisions, treating people fairly and honestly, and staying humble.
scales.work: 適合需要按時交付、處理敏感資料，或要公平對待各方的工作；可以主動負責檢查和跟進。
scales.workEn: Suits work with firm deadlines, sensitive data or several parties to treat fairly; volunteer to own checking and follow-up.
scales.interview: 準備一個你按承諾完成任務，或在壓力下堅守原則的例子。
scales.interviewEn: Prepare an example of delivering on a commitment or holding to your principles under pressure.

scales.label: 精進
scales.about: 獨立思考、判斷力強，並且能夠帶動別人一起做事。
scales.aboutEn: Thinking independently, exercising sound judgement and getting people to work together.
scales.work: 適合需要提出新方法、作出判斷或協調不同人的工作；可以爭取帶領小組項目。
scales.workEn: Suits work that needs new approaches, judgement calls or coordination across people; ask to lead a small project.
scales.interview: 準備一個你提出新想法，並說服別人一起完成的例子。
scales.interviewEn: Prepare an example of proposing a new idea and persuading others to deliver it with you.

items.text: 遇到困難時，我仍然保持希望。
我覺得生活中沒有甚麼值得感恩。
items.textEn: Find few things in my life to be grateful for.

items.text: 我會說謊，讓自己避過麻煩。
items.textEn: Lie to get myself out of trouble.

items.text: 我不會為自己的信念據理力爭。
items.textEn: Do not stand up for my beliefs.

items.text: 我期待每一個新的日子。
items.textEn: Look forward to each new day.

items.text: 別人絕不會形容我自大。
items.textEn: Would never be described as arrogant.

items.text: 我對人生有成熟的看法。
items.textEn: Have a mature view on life.
Find it hard to forgive others.

items.text: 別人向我傾訴問題時，我會不耐煩。
items.textEn: Get impatient when others talk to me about their problems.

items.text: 我很難估計別人會有甚麼反應。
items.textEn: Have trouble guessing how others will react.

items.text: 我知道身邊有人關心我，就像關心他們自己一樣。
items.textEn: Know that there are people in my life who care as much for me as for themselves.

items.text: 我相信每個人的權利都同樣重要。
items.textEn: Believe that everyone's rights are equally important.
Am valued by my friends for my good judgment.

items.text: 我很難接受別人對我的關愛。
items.textEn: Have difficulty accepting love from anyone.

items.text: 我很難令別人一起合作。
items.textEn: Have difficulty getting others to work together.
